The Places API (New) is a service that accepts HTTP requests for location data through a variety of methods. It returns formatted location data and imagery about establishments, geographic locations, or prominent points of interest. The API supports Text Search, Nearby Search, Place Details, Place Photos, and Autocomplete. Responses on the New API are shaped by the required X-Goog-FieldMask header, which controls exactly which fields are returned and which billing SKU applies.
